slides.title: Validating with Zod
slides.html:
Zod

Validating with Zod

  • Describe the shape once
  • safeParse never throws
  • Returns clean, typed data
  • Unknown fields are stripped

schemas/post.js

import { z } from "zod";
 
export const createPostSchema = z.object({
  title: z.string().trim().min(3).max(150),
  body: z.string().min(20),
  tags: z.array(z.string().toLowerCase()).max(5).default([]),
  status: z.enum(["draft", "published"]).default("draft"),
});
 
const r = createPostSchema.safeParse(req.body);
// r.success · r.data (clean) · r.error

slides.title: A reusable validate middleware
slides.html:
Middleware

A reusable validate middleware

  • Validate body, query or params
  • 400 with a list of problems
  • Replace input with the clean version

middleware/validate.js

export const validate = (schema, where = "body") =>
  (req, res, next) => {
    const result = schema.safeParse(req[where]);
    if (!result.success) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        message: "Validation failed",
        errors: result.error.issues.map((i) => i.path.join(".") + ": " + i.message),
      });
    }
    req.valid = result.data;
    next();
  };
 
router.post("/", protect, validate(createPostSchema), posts.create);

slides.title: Custom error classes
slides.html:
Errors

Custom error classes

  • One class with a status code
  • Throw anywhere, handle in one place
  • Mark expected errors as operational

utils/errors.js

export class AppError extends Error {
  constructor(status, message) {
    super(message);
    this.status = status;
    this.isOperational = true;
  }
}
 
export const notFound = (what = "Resource") =>
  new AppError(404, `${what} not found`);
 
// in a controller
if (!post) throw notFound("Post");

slides.title: A central error handler
slides.html:
Handler

A central error handler

  • Translate known errors to statuses
  • Hide details of unknown errors
  • Same JSON shape every time

middleware/error.js

export function errorHandler(err, req, res, next) {
  if (err.isOperational)
    return res.status(err.status).json({ message: err.message });
  if (err.name === "CastError")
    return res.status(400).json({ message: `Invalid ${err.path}` });
  if (err.code === 11000)
    return res.status(409).json({ message: "Already exists" });
 
  console.error(err);
  res.status(500).json({ message: "Something went wrong" });
}

slides.title: Logging that helps you debug
slides.html:
Logging

Logging that helps you debug

  • Structured JSON logs
  • A request id on every line
  • Never log passwords or tokens

logger.js

import pino from "pino";
import pinoHttp from "pino-http";
 
export const logger = pino({
  level: process.env.LOG_LEVEL || "info",
  redact: ["req.headers.authorization", "req.headers.cookie"],
});
 
app.use(pinoHttp({ logger }));
 
// anywhere in a request
req.log.info({ postId: post.id }, "post created");

slides.title: Headers, CORS and body limits
slides.html:
Hardening

Headers, CORS and body limits

  • helmet: safe headers in one line
  • CORS: only your frontend
  • Small body limits stop huge payloads
  • Hide the Express fingerprint

server.js

import helmet from "helmet";
import cors from "cors";
 
app.disable("x-powered-by");
app.use(helmet());
app.use(cors({ origin: process.env.CLIENT_URL, credentials: true }));
app.use(express.json({ limit: "100kb" }));

slides.title: Rate limiting
slides.html:
Rate limits

Rate limiting

  • Stops brute force on login
  • Protects expensive routes
  • Return 429 with a clear message

server.js

import rateLimit from "express-rate-limit";
 
const authLimiter = rateLimit({
  windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000,  // 15 minutes
  limit: 10,                 // per IP
  standardHeaders: "draft-7",
  message: { message: "Too many attempts, try again in 15 minutes" },
});
 
app.use("/api/auth/login", authLimiter);
app.use("/api", rateLimit({ windowMs: 60_000, limit: 120 }));

slides.title: Query validation with coercion
slides.html:
Build

Query validation with coercion

  • Query values arrive as strings
  • z.coerce converts them
  • Defaults and limits in one place

schemas/post.js

export const listPostsQuery = z.object({
  page: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).default(1),
  limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(50).default(10),
  tag: z.string().toLowerCase().optional(),
  q: z.string().max(100).optional(),
  sort: z.enum(["newest", "oldest", "popular"]).default("newest"),
});
 
router.get("/", validate(listPostsQuery, "query"), posts.list);
